snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM0_GROUP1_ID1: This is your very own tree-house. It belongs to your panda and no one else. You can even lock it by clicking on the key icon on the right.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM0_GROUP1_ID2: Of course it is most comfortable if you decorate it. There are LOADS of really cool things to put in your tree-house. You can even buy yourself a completely new home! Just click on the folding ruler at the bottom right to find out more.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM3_GROUP1_ID1: I can't go into the water, because I would rust! It is a real shame. However, for pandas this is one of the most popular places on Panfu. One of my favorite games is located next to the diving board. It is called Bolly Hop.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM4_GROUP1_ID1: There are three great shops you can go in here. Go to the ice-cream parlour from which you can also reach the library. Go to the giftshop to buy new clothes or go to the pet shop and buy yourself a cute little Bolly.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM4_GROUP1_ID2: If you prefer the old City, you can go visit it by typing "goto town" in the chat.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM5_GROUP1_ID1: Want to look good? Then buy some funky clothes! Just click on the catalogue which is lying on the floor.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM6_GROUP1_ID1: Want to look good? Then buy some funky clothes! Just click on the catalogue which is lying on the floor.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM7_GROUP1_ID1: Have you always wanted your own pet? Now you can have one! You see the cute little Bollys in the corner? You can buy one (or even two or three!) and get loads of cool toys for it to play with. Click on the catalogue to find out more.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM8_GROUP1_ID1: Why not have a race with your friends? Line up at the starting position and click on the panda standing by the clock. The stopwatch will start counting up. You can also play a game of football by clicking on the football.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM9_GROUP1_ID1: Want to know who the best players in Panfu are? Simply click on the scoreboard and you will find out.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM10_GROUP1_ID1: There is a strange smell in this room... must be all the dirty sports clothes. Sometimes there are things hidden in this room. Take a close look ... is anything hidden here now?
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM11_GROUP1_ID1: This is the volcano on Panfu. Be careful to not get too close to the lava, otherwise you might get roasted! There is one game hidden here and you can watch the sky through the telescope.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM12_GROUP1_ID1: Welcome to the jungle! As far as I know, there are no dangerous creatures here, but I have heard that some pandas have mysteriously gone missing after going into the jungle. There are two games in the jungle, as well as the info-point which will allow you to become a tour guide. Click on the kiosk and you will be given instructions.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM13_GROUP1_ID1: This is Panfu's castle. There are many exciting things inside, including the Panfu disco. Have you clicked on the boat beside the castle yet? Make sure you don't fall in the moat when you cross the drawbridge because there's a crocodile in it!
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM14_GROUP1_ID1: From here you can enter the disco, play City Runner -- a really cool game -- or get to Kamaria's tower.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM15_GROUP1_ID1: The statue in the corner is a great friend of mine. He doesn't talk much but we both use the same anti-corrosion spray.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM16_GROUP1_ID1: This ballroom has just recently been renovated to the original state it was in 1678, when the 27th Hanno of Panfu built it. In more recent times it has also been used for ceremonies, like the wedding of our two alien friends Nui and Trawui.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM17_GROUP1_ID1: This terrace offers you magnificent views of Panfu. Sometimes it gets very windy here: I once heard of a small Panda that was blown away and never seen again! There are two games here and the entrance to Kamaria's tower.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM18_GROUP1_ID1: Often there are very cool parties in here. There is a resident DJ who plays music day and night! You can also play the puzzle game Globy in here. Check it out.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM19_GROUP1_ID1: There is always a lot happening on the beach. Can you see the pier? That is the way to the underwater school. You will need to buy a scuba diving suit before you can get there. Go to the city and buy one now from the catalogue!
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM1_GROUP1_ID1: Welcome to the ice cream parlour. Which flavour ice-cream is your favourite? Mine is engine-oil with a sprinkling of copper. You can get to the library from here via the door to the right hand side.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM20_GROUP1_ID1: This is Kamaria's study. Be careful in here and don't touch anything without her permission. If you click on her crystal ball, you will get a daily dose of wisdom.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM21_GROUP1_ID1: Oooooh, I hate this place. It is really damp in here and I go rusty if I stay here too long. There is a rumour that there was once a family of giant spiders that made a nest in here. Maybe they will come back one day? You can reach Professor Bookworm's laboratory from here: it is the door on the left.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM22_GROUP1_ID1: Isn't this a beautiful place? I especially like the fountain. You can reach the beauty salon and the posh restaurant from here.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM23_GROUP1_ID1: Oh, how I like the beauty salon! I always go here when I get a little squeaky and need to be oiled. See the catwalk down the middle? You can wear your favourite clothes and show them off to your friends. There is also a really cool game in this room: it's called Makeover.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM24_GROUP1_ID1: This place is a little rough when there are pirates around. Watch out for them. One of my favorite games is located here. Can you find it?
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM25_GROUP1_ID1: The bottom of the sea! You can only go here with a diving suit!
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM26_GROUP1_ID1: This is where Professor Bookworm carries out his experiments. It also contains his legendary music machine: the Sintepan. Give it a try!
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM27_GROUP1_ID1: Well done for making it here. A few pandas are afraid of the sharks and don't want to come down here. You can get into the classrooms from here.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM28_GROUP1_ID1: There are two really cool games hidden in this room. After playing them you will be far cleverer than you were before. That is the point of classrooms, right?
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM29_GROUP1_ID1: Here you can play 4 Boom against your friends. Simply click on any game table - you might have to wait for someone to join you.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM2_GROUP1_ID1: We call this the library on Panfu. You can even read the books here -- just click on them! There is also a game laid out on the table. You have to have a good memory to play it, though!
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM30_GROUP1_ID1: Here we are at Panfu's first restaurant "Chez Bruno". You can play the cool game called "Quick Service". How good are you at waiting tables?
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM31_GROUP1_ID1: Welcome to Panfu's Pony Stables! Don't move around too much or you'll scare the pony! From here you can also get to the place to play a great game, 'Funny Farm'.
snippets.ASSISTANT_LOCAL_ROOM32_GROUP1_ID1: Here we are in the stall. And as you can see, there are really horses here! In the 'Happy Horse' game you can test out just how well you get on with horses.
